edges.trigger: Sales converts a reviewed CRFQ; the deal number carries over (CRFQ-2026-0042 → QTN-2026-0042).
Quotation desk approves + marks sent; the rep confirms the order with the customer (stage: Quotation Sent → Customer Confirm).
Quotation converts to an HC (Site PIC + address gate); Ops schedules it — binds units and creates the first Delivery Order + Job.
Scheduling reserves units (IN → RESERVED); Completed delivery sets them OUT; a processed return brings them back IN.
Ops assigns a driver to a DO; the driver gets a delivery.driver_assigned notification and the job appears in the app.
Driver uploads the signed HC and marks Delivered; Ops validates → Completed and the HC stage becomes Delivered.
Rep raises breakdown / replacement / upgrade / return on a Delivered HC; Ops processes it into a Collection / Replacement / Service_Breakdown DO.
Ops flags and publishes the PO in the PO workspace; Finance previews & verifies it in the Document Hub, which creates the draft IVN in the Billing Queue.
On collection Ops records condition_status; compensation_required flows to Finance Returns for a credit note / charge.
AR overlay surfaces overdue / flagged customers on My Customers, Leads and the Customer Master risk strip.
A breakdown ticket spawns a Service_Breakdown DO; returned units under_inspection go to Plant for post-delivery inspection and repair.
Plant closes the work order / technical service; the unit's status returns to IN and its meter reading + service history update.
Target: Ops may only schedule a unit that passed pre-delivery inspection.

terms.definition: Customer Request For Quotation. The captured inquiry; the first document.
the priced, approvable offer sent to the customer. Has a stored `status` and a **derived** `stage`.
the confirmed agreement: machines, rates, site. Tracks two independent axes (`status` + `workflow_stage`).
the physical delivery/collection job a driver runs.
a machine _model_ (e.g. a 25-tonne crane). The catalog entry.

an item code flagged **`is_serialized`** ("Tracked by machine ID"): a machine whose HC lines must be filled with per-unit machine assignments before scheduling. Non-serialized codes (consumables, spares) carry a quantity only.

the independent, hand-curated labels on an item code (`is_serialized`, `stock_type`, `item_type`, `show_in_white_board`). Each answers exactly one question; none is inferred from another, and none stands in for another when it's empty — an unreadable label shows `—`.

what kind of thing an item code is: Machine · Spareparts · Services · General · Others · Transport · Accessories. A governed vocabulary, not free text, but **optional** — a third of codes have none, and no reader may supply one. Distinct from the line-level `item_type` on RFQ / quotation / order lines, which describes the line rather than the item.
a single physical asset of an item code (serial-numbered). Its `item_unit_status` is the one axis for where it is.
the unit's lifecycle: IN (available) · RESERVED (bound) · OUT (on hire) · SOLD/SCRAP/LOANED/NA (terminal).
a named bundle of item codes (e.g. "Cranes"). Many-to-many with categories; a group can be both hire and sale.
how a line is classified for pricing (Hire of Machinery, Sale of Machinery, …). Whether it's rental is the **`is_rental`** boolean, _not_ the name.
per-item rental pricing in three tiers: **Lowest / Standard / Highest** (SGD). Standard is the default.
the consolidated view of every item's rate tiers.
a return / replacement / breakdown request raised against a Delivered HC; spawns the matching DO.
the kind of DO: Delivery · Collection · Replacement · Service_Breakdown.
moving part of a delivery onto a separate child DO (move-semantics; nothing duplicated).
releasing a unit: re-point it to another slot that needs it, or free it to IN if nothing does.
the mobile view a driver uses for delivery + collection. Gated by the `driver.app` permission.
the shared suffix carried down CRFQ → QTN → HC → DO, so one deal is traceable end-to-end.
Person In Charge at the delivery site; required to convert a quotation to an HC.
the compound freeze on editing an HC/quotation: editable status **and** not Delivered **and** not Repeated-order **and** no live DO.
a value computed on read, never stored (e.g. quotation stage).
a value frozen onto a document at conversion (e.g. delivery address, item description, and unit of measure on the HC) so later source edits don't rewrite history.
a deal-level delivery fee set on the quotation, carried onto the HC and itemised there; advisory-only (never re-billed) at the delivery order.
the operating unit a document belongs to; most numbering and reads scope by branch.
Invoice number / the invoice record in the Billing Queue. Climbs the ladder Draft → Approved (junior) → Published (senior) → Sent.
Finance's work list: every contract that reached Finance with a verified PO carries a real draft IVN here, with priority dot, billing type (STD / ADV / COD) and progress.
One shared PO record per contract: upload → match → cross-check → stamp → publish. Finance's Preview & Verify step lives here.
Company-grouped PO ageing board shared by Ops and Finance, driven by one stored po_flagged_date. Ops flags + publishes; Finance verifies.
Where a PO sits with Finance: preview_verify (asking) → verified. Green is reserved for verified; asking states wear the warning outline.
standard (one PO : one HC) or split (one PO governs several contracts / several POs on one contract). Split flows can keep, supersede or replace the governing PO.
A revised customer PO replacing the governing one; draft IVNs auto-sync the new PO number + cut-off, approved / published ones get a guarded compare, sent ones are locked.
The PO's billing cut-off carried onto the invoice; a PO-vs-invoice mismatch shows a banner in the composer.
Finance document reversing part of an invoice — compensation on damaged return, early return, or a billing correction.
What a salesperson raises from My Service Tickets: breakdown, replacement, upgrade, full or partial return on a Delivered HC. Stored as an ops ticket (hc_ops_ticket).
Ops' judgement of a returned machine's condition: good_condition · compensation_required · under_inspection · pending_return. compensation_required goes to Finance.
Target role: plans delivery and return-collection jobs and driver rosters (today part of the operations role).
Plant checks a unit before it leaves the yard and after it returns; the return check feeds the compensation assessment.
A Plant repair / maintenance job on a unit with required parts and status (work_order_status, item_status Required → …).
A servicing record per unit (item_unit_technical_service) with meter reading and next due.
Procurement's request for quotation to a supplier (rfq_status Sent → …); the winning quote becomes a purchase order.
Procurement's order to a supplier with three status axes: po_status, delivery_status, billing_status. Not the customer PO Finance verifies.
The customer's purchase order for a hire / sale — Ops publishes it, Finance verifies it, the invoice quotes it. Distinct from a supplier PO.
A counting cycle over item units at a location with adjustments and reasons (stock_take_cycle, stock_adjustment).
The yard's at-a-glance machine board; an item code opts in via show_in_white_board (one of the four independent classification labels).
Binary label Stock / Non-Stock on an item code — never inferred from item_type or any other label.
Rep-only workspace of prospective accounts with a parking-state pipeline, AI snapshot and a background-scan gate into the Customer Master.
The partner dossier: identity header, risk strip, and tabs for order history, relationships, payment and documents.
A Hiring Contract tracks status (Draft / Scheduled / …) and workflow_stage (… / Delivered) independently; Delivered is the pair Scheduled + Delivered.
A notification scoped to a whole department feed (sales, quotation, ops, plant, ar, finance) rather than a person.
